title: Restart the Servex keeper once, so the crash evidence goes live

owner_note.text: The supervisor that keeps Servex up has run the same code since Tuesday; a Servex restart never swaps it, and I am not allowed to stop it. Until it restarts, the crash breadcrumbs and crash-loop warning landed yesterday stay dormant. In a terminal at the repo root: `node Servex/sustain.mjs --stop` then `node Servex/sustain.mjs`; the dev servers and the site come back on their own within a minute.
